_comment: Remote MCP config — copy this to ~/.claude.json (Claude Code) on each laptop.
_instructions: 1. Replace <YOUR_VERCEL_URL> with your Vercel project URL (e.g. https://your-app.vercel.app)
2. Replace <YOUR_QUO_SERVER_TOKEN> with the QUO_SERVER_TOKEN you set in Vercel
3. That's it — no QUO API key needed on each laptop, the server handles that
